title: Spacing and Sizing Tokens knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Spacing and Sizing Tokens?
options: It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
shared tokens, utilities and component patterns should clarify rather than hide design decisions
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
questions.answer_key: shared tokens, utilities and component patterns should clarify rather than hide design decisions
questions.explanation: Spacing and Sizing Tokens is best understood through the syllabus topics: Spacing variables, Sizing consistency, Container-size variables. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with spacing and sizing tokens?
options: Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
document reusable classes and test their variants in a real component
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
questions.answer_key: document reusable classes and test their variants in a real component
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Spacing variables, Sizing consistency, Container-size variables, Reusing values across components.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying spacing and sizing tokens?
options: duplicating one-off values in many components increases design drift
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
questions.answer_key: duplicating one-off values in many components increases design drift
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
